preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(k, int) and 1 <= k <= n <= 1024
preconditions.description: n and k are integers within the specified bounds.
n and k are powers of two.
The total query limit constraint holds.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in a)
preconditions.description: The hidden array a has length n with values between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The program outputs the correct number of distinct coffee varieties in the array a.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('? ')) <= (3 * n * n) // (2 * k)
postconditions.description: The total number of taste queries does not exceed the allowed limit.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() == 'R') <= 30000
postconditions.description: The total number of reset queries does not exceed 30,000.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('? '))
postconditions.description: All taste queries reference valid café indices between 1 and n.
